families.name: A question we can test

options.text: Every object always doubles its distance

options.text: All towels absorb any liquid instantly

families.name: Competing explanations
families.description: Two changed factors can leave uncertainty.

tasks.prompt: A plant in light with water grew; a plant in darkness without water did not. What can we conclude about light alone?

options.text: This comparison cannot isolate light from water

options.text: The evidence is insufficient for a size-only rule

stories.title: Stories & Feelings
stories.intro: Original stories with several possible helpful paths. A grown-up may narrate. Feelings are not right or wrong.
stories.guide: Ask what the character might need and what else could help. Respect boundaries. An emotion guess is a possibility, not a diagnosis. Story paths do not produce behavior scores.

levels.name: Notice
levels.goal: Notice an event and possible feelings

tasks.prompt: Rabbit dropped a book while walking. What fell?
tasks.explain: The story says the book fell.

tasks.prompt: Bear brought a cup to Rabbit. What did Bear bring?
tasks.explain: The story names the cup.

start.text: Rabbit cannot find a favorite toy. What might Rabbit feel?

end0.text: Rabbit might feel sad about missing the toy.

end1.text: Rabbit might worry about where the toy is.

end2.text: We can ask Rabbit; a picture does not tell us everything.

tasks.guide: Explore one possible path, then try another. More than one choice may be helpful. No feeling is scored as wrong.

start.text: Bear sees a new playground. What might Bear feel?

end0.text: Bear might feel excited to explore.

tasks.guide: Explore one possible path, then try another. More than one choice may be helpful. No feeling is scored as wrong.
